description: This file defines a PHP class 'EmailSubscriptionSearchFilterParams' within the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Admin\Dto'. The class extends a base class 'FilterParams' and sets a default sort field for email subscription search filtering. It appears to be part of a Human Resource Management system and functions as a Data Transfer Object (DTO) for filtering email subscription search results.
